item.title: Assam Presents ₹62,294 Crore Interim Budget, Projects ₹10 Lakh Crore Economy by 2028
item.description: GUWAHATI: The Assam government on Tuesday, February 17, presented an interim budget of ₹62,294.78 crore for the initial months of the 2026–27 financial year, ahead of the upcoming Assembly elections. Finance Minister Ajanta Neog sought spending approval to ensure that government operations continue smoothly from April 1 until a full budget is introduced later in the year. item.title: 14 Former Captains, Including Sunil Gavaskar and Kapil Dev, Appeal to Pakistan Government Over Imran Khan’s Health
item.description: GUWAHATI: Fourteen former international cricket captains, including Indian legends Sunil Gavaskar and Kapil Dev, have jointly appealed to the Government of Pakistan to ensure the welfare and proper medical care of Pakistan’s 1992 World Cup-winning skipper Imran Khan, citing serious concerns over his deteriorating health in custody. item.title: Tarique Rahman First Male in Over 30 Years to Become Bangladesh PM; Lok Sabha Speaker Om Birla Attends Swearing-In
item.description: GUWAHATI: Tarique Rahman was sworn in as the Prime Minister of Bangladesh on Tuesday, February 17, marking a decisive turn in the country’s governance. Earlier in the day, Rahman and newly elected Members of Parliament from the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP) took the oath at the National Parliament complex in Dhaka. item.title: NGT Clears Great Nicobar Island Mega Project, Disposes Applications Related to Environment Clearance
item.description: GUWAHATI: The National Green Tribunal (NGT) on Monday, February 16, cleared the way for the approximately ₹80,000-crore Great Nicobar Island mega-infrastructure project, observing that “considering the strategic importance” of the project and “other relevant considerations”, it found no valid grounds to interfere with the environmental clearance (EC) granted in 2022. item.title: Cheetah ‘Gamini’ Gives Birth to Three Cubs at Kuno National Park in Madhya Pradesh
